title: Vertical Hierarchy / Descent Into Consequence
observed_structure: status or abstraction is organized vertically
downward movement increases bodily or material consequence
return upward is altered by knowledge or cost acquired below
cinematic_affordances: camera height lowering with increasing consequence
return framing preserving evidence of descent
cultural_scope: comparative vertical structure; do not assign fixed moral value to upward or downward movement
transferable_structure: movement through vertical levels converts abstract rank into increasing material consequence and altered return
non_transferable_surface: borrowed cosmological diagrams or culturally specific sacred geography without provenance
